name: Frost Serpent
fantasy: A wingless ice dragon with crystal antlers. It swims over the ground, strikes with claw and fang and lashes its tail in a full turn.

directions.name: Glacier
directions.desc: Tombs of ice and a hide of it: lock them down, then break them.

skills.name: Frost Breath
skills.desc: Breathe a freezing gale in a 7 m cone for over 1 s, dealing cold damage repeatedly and chilling foes. Ice bursts up where it ends.

skills.name: Glacial Tomb
skills.desc: Encase the foe nearest the pointer and all within 2.5 m in ice for 1.6 s. The tomb then shatters for 180% weapon damage, 90% to others within 3 m.
skills.role: lock a pack, then shatter it

skills.name: Crushing Coil
skills.desc: Coil your body around you: 130% weapon damage within 4.2 m, slowing foes 45% for 2 s. Chilled foes take 30% more.

skills.name: Rime Lance
skills.desc: Breathe a 10 m line of ice spikes: 125% weapon damage to every foe on it, chilling them. Already-chilled foes freeze for 1 s.

rites.name: Permafrost
rites.text: Every {n}th hit on a chilled foe freezes it solid for {secs} s.

rites.name: Brittle
rites.text: Chilled foes take +{more}% damage from your hits.

rites.name: Rending Claws
rites.text: +{dmg:attack}% claw and bite damage and +{crit}% critical chance.

rites.name: Primal Fury
rites.text: Each kill: +{dmg}% damage for {secs} s, up to {stacks} times.

rites.name: Frozen Blood
rites.text: Chills last {chill_pct}% longer and Frost Breath deals +{dmg:frost_breath}% damage.

rites.name: Deep Freeze
rites.text: Glacial Tomb seals {tomb_r}% wider, holds {tomb_t} s longer and shatters {dmg:s_tomb}% harder.

rites.name: Iron Coils
rites.text: Crushing Coil reaches {coil_r}% further, hits {dmg:s_coil}% harder and heals {coil_shield}% of your life per foe crushed.

rites.name: Spear of Winter
rites.text: Rime Lance runs {lance_len}% further, freezes {lance_freeze} s longer and hits {dmg:s_lance}% harder.

rites.name: Biting Cold
rites.text: Chills last {chill_pct}% longer and Glacial Tomb deals +{dmg:s_tomb}% damage.

rites.name: Frozen Barbs
rites.text: Foes that strike you take {pct}% of the blow back as cold.

rites.name: Shatterpoint
rites.text: Chilled foes that die burst into ice shards: {pct}% weapon damage within {r} m, chilling.

rites.name: Heart of the Glacier
rites.text: Survive a killing blow at {life}% life inside a shell of ice, once every {secs} s.
